about: Knowledge objects held out of Learning Goal selection by an owner ruling. Ids only, with the ruling verbatim. A hold is consulted at selection, in both pathways; it never edits a candidate pool, so a held object is still listed among a goal's candidates and shown as held. The mechanism demonstration named beside each hold is where the object stays usable as engineering.

holds.ruling: Please keep the current Pass Combination Gate as a mechanism demonstration only. I do not want it reintroduced into learning-design examples until we've reviewed its ecological suitability.
